name: lands-of-glory
description: Lands of Glory - Digital Board Game Prototype

scripts.build: npm --workspace=@lands-of-glory/game-core run build && npm --workspace=lands-of-glory-prototype run build
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:integration && npm run test:structure
scripts.lint: npm --workspace=@lands-of-glory/game-core run lint && npm --workspace=lands-of-glory-prototype run lint
scripts.type-check: npm --workspace=@lands-of-glory/game-core run build && npm --workspace=lands-of-glory-prototype run type-check && tsc --project contracts/tsconfig.json
